titre: La production chinoise d'aluminium touche son plafond
sous_titre: Production chinoise d'aluminium primaire, en millions de tonnes, et plafond de capacité

2022.texte: Output climbed by 4.5% from the previous year to 40.21million tonnes

2023.texte: churned out 41.59 million metric tons of primary aluminium last year

2024.texte: Cumulatively, production rose 4.6% YoY to around 44mt over Jan’24 – Dec’24.

2025.texte: China's primary aluminum output totalled 45.02 million tonnes during 2025

Plafond de capacité.texte: exceeded the 45 million tonnes/year capacity cap
